landing.intro: walks programmers through a 5-stage secure software development lifecycle. Each stage combines an AI prompt engine with NIST SP 800-218 and produces ISO 27001-ready documentation — source code, manual book, and compliance report.
landing.featSdlcDesc: Analysis → Design → Development → Testing → Handover, each stage enforced by NIST SP 800-218.
landing.featIsoDesc: Every stage maps automatically to ISO 27001:2022 Annex A for audit-ready compliance reports.
landing.featByokDesc: Connect your own AI provider (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Anthropic, Ollama). Keys stay encrypted.
landing.featGithubDesc: Push finished code straight to your repository with a DevSecOps CI/CD pipeline included.
landing.featPromptDesc: Chat with the AI at every stage to generate, review, and revise your website.
landing.featSecureDesc: Threat models, secure coding, vulnerability scanning and auto-fix as a built-in workflow.

dashboard.title: Projects Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Create, manage, and monitor security compliance for your AI-generated websites.
dashboard.empty: No projects yet. Create your first AI-generated secure website!
dashboard.name: Name
dashboard.contentLanguageHint: Language for generated pages, text, and documentation.
dashboard.phRequirements: Describe what the website must do, target users, data handled, integrations...
dashboard.phUiPreferences: Describe desired layout, color palette, required pages (home, login, dashboard, etc.), visual style, site references...
dashboard.templateEcommerceDesc: An online store with product catalog, cart, checkout, and order management.
dashboard.templateEcommerceReq: Public product catalog, customer accounts, cart + checkout with payment, admin order management, order history, payment data handling (PCI awareness), CSRF and injection protection.
dashboard.templateSaasDesc: A multi-tenant SaaS dashboard with billing and role-based access.
dashboard.templateSaasReq: Tenant isolation, user roles (admin/member), dashboard with metrics, subscription billing, API endpoints with rate limiting, audit logging of sensitive actions.
dashboard.templateRestApiDesc: A REST API backend with auth, rate limiting, and secure data access.
dashboard.templateRestApiReq: JWT or OAuth2 authentication, role-based access control, input validation, rate limiting, structured error responses, SQL-injection/XSS-safe data access, API documentation.
dashboard.templateLmsDesc: A learning portal with courses, lessons, enrollments, and progress tracking.
dashboard.templateLmsReq: Instructor and learner roles, course & lesson management, enrollment flow, progress tracking, file upload with type/size validation, PII protection for learner data.

analysis.name: Analysis & Requirements
analysis.desc: Scope the website, recommend language/stack, define security requirements & data classification.

scope.label: Project Scope & Objectives
scope.detail: Define website goals, target audience, and functional scope.

stack.label: Stack Recommendation
stack.detail: Select language, framework, database, and hosting with security justification.

security.label: Security & Privacy Requirements
security.detail: Specify authentication, data privacy, and regulatory constraints.

data.label: Data Classification
data.detail: Classify data types handled by the application (public, sensitive, PII).

recommendations.label: Security Recommendations (≥3)
recommendations.detail: Provide at least 3 actionable security recommendations with step-by-step guidance.

design.name: Design & Architecture
design.desc: UI/UX layout, threat model, architecture diagram, database schema and auth flow design.

ui.label: UI/UX Design & Page Layout
ui.detail: Design page layout, wireframes, color palette, and component structure.

architecture.label: Architecture & Data Flow
architecture.detail: Define component architecture, trust boundaries, and system interactions.

stride.label: STRIDE Threat Model
stride.detail: Identify threats, impact, likelihood, and mitigation strategies.

diagram.label: Mermaid Architecture Diagram
diagram.detail: Generate visual architecture and data flow diagrams.

schema.label: Database Schema & Auth Flow
schema.detail: Design database models, relationships, and authentication/authorization flow.

recommendations.label: Architecture Security Recommendations (≥3)
recommendations.detail: Provide at least 3 architecture security recommendations with actionable steps.

development.name: Secure Development
development.desc: Implement UI/frontend pages and generate secure source code with NIST PW.5 secure coding.

frontend.label: Frontend & UI Implementation
frontend.detail: Generate responsive page layouts, UI components, and styling based on design.

scaffold.label: Project Scaffolding & Config
scaffold.detail: Set up project structure, configuration, environment templates, and CI security.

auth.label: Authentication & Authorization
auth.detail: Implement secure user authentication, password hashing, and session management.

antiInjection.label: Anti-Injection & Output Encoding
antiInjection.detail: Implement parameterized queries/ORM and XSS output encoding.

secrets.label: Secrets Handling & CSRF Protection
secrets.detail: Implement CSRF protection, environment secrets management, and safe error handling.

recommendations.label: Secure Coding Recommendations (≥3)
recommendations.detail: Provide at least 3 secure coding recommendations with action steps.

testing.name: Security Testing & Audit
testing.desc: Scan for vulnerabilities, assess security score, and auto-fix issues.

owasp.label: OWASP Top 10 Review
owasp.detail: Audit generated source code files for OWASP Top 10 security vulnerabilities.

score.label: Security Score Assessment
score.detail: Calculate security score (0–100) based on vulnerability findings and compliance.

remediation.label: Remediation & Fix Suggestions
remediation.detail: Generate code fixes for identified security findings for user review.

recommendations.label: Security Audit Recommendations (≥3)
recommendations.detail: Provide at least 3 security audit recommendations with actionable steps.

handover.name: Handover & Deliverables
handover.desc: Export source code to ZIP or push to GitHub with full documentation and ISO report.

manual.label: Manual Book & Documentation
manual.detail: Generate deployment guide, environment setup, endpoints, and page documentation.

compliance.label: ISO 27001 Compliance Report
compliance.detail: Generate ISO 27001 Annex A crosswalk report and NIST SSDF compliance summary.

checklist.label: Release Security Checklist
checklist.detail: Verify secure defaults, backup configuration, audit logging, and deployment readiness.

export.label: Source Code Export & GitHub Push
export.detail: Prepare source code bundle (ZIP) or push to connected GitHub repository.

recommendations.label: Final Release Recommendations (≥3)
recommendations.detail: Provide at least 3 release security recommendations with actionable steps.

deliverables.title: Final Deliverables
deliverables.congrats: Your website passed all 5 Secure SDLC stages.
deliverables.pushGithub: Push directly to your GitHub repository
deliverables.existingRepo: Or push to an existing repo (URL)
deliverables.existingRepoHint: Leave empty to create a new repository with the name above.
deliverables.githubPatHint: No GitHub OAuth connected? Paste a fine-grained or classic PAT with "repo" scope. It is encrypted before storage.
deliverables.badgeHint: Paste this badge into your README to show the SecureSDLC compliance pipeline.
deliverables.errPushPat: Push failed. Provide a Personal Access Token with repo scope, or re-authenticate with GitHub.
deliverables.phRevSummary: e.g. Add input validation, upgrade auth to OAuth2, improve mobile layout...
deliverables.badgeLocked: Finish the project to publish the badge.
deliverables.incompleteNotice: Project in progress — {completed}/{total} stages completed. Finish all stages to unlock badge & revision.
